notes.title: New Game Announcement Tonight during Summer Game Fest livestream
notes.notes:
Hey touchers-of-art!

Today/tonight I'm revealing my new art-based game [i]'Please, Watch The Artwork'[/i] during the Day Of The Devs stream, part of Summer Game Fest.

[i]'Please, Watch The Artwork'[/i] is a spin-off from the [i]'Please, Touch The Artwork'[/i]-series, but [b]NO WORRIES: 'Please, Touch The Artwork 3' is also in the making![/b]

I will give a small introduction on why/how I made the game and you'll get to see the world premier of the trailer!

Tune in Friday June 6th (today) at 4pm Pacific Time, 7pm Eastern Time, 1am CEST, right after the official livestream of Summer Game Fest.

Link to the livestream:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-Hr6Q2hln_M&ab_channel=thegameawards

Link to the steam-page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3542500/Please_Watch_The_Artwork/

I'm excited, hope you are too!
Thomas
